notes.title: Rework
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The news and updates have been sparse, development slow, [b]BUT[/b] - we keep on pushing to get this game together!
[/p][h3]Where are we at the moment?[/h3][p]We have had a shorter period with a bit of help from two students this summer, which have been a lot of fun, very teachable for for us all and progress have been made.
Nothing though that has really sufficed an update for the Game or Demo. But definitely things that are good for Blessed Curse's development in the longrun.

One [b]very big[/b] decision that had to be made is that the project needs to be reworked from the ground up as to create a more clean and stable ground. Both as the project has been a mess and a lot of lessons has been learned on how to do it better, but also because Unreal Engine itself started to bug out and migrating to a new project did unfortunately not help.[/p][p]We did also try other solutions but nothing was as stable as reworking.[/p][p][/p][h3]Look forward to it![/h3][p]With the rework, graphics and potentially some gameplay elements will change a bit to! All of it resulting in a better, prettier and stronger core gameloop![/p][p][/p][p]Will try to keep the updates a bit more frequent now also moving forward.[/p]

tags.feature: With the rework, graphics and potentially some gameplay elements will change a bit to!

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
We are now happy to be releasing our forth update. The weekly streak continues, albeit one day late this time. 

[b]What to look forward to in the coming weeks: [/b]
There is more soundwork in the pipeline. We are also working on updates to the animations we have. Very soon, there will be a working navigateable menu in the world, which will replace the typical lobby menu.

And of course, more improvements and updates to excising systems and maps.

We are eagerly listening to any and all feedback and will adjust work process accordingly.  

[h2]Known issues[/h2] 
The loadout menu does not do anything yet. But the Truck will have two of every item spawned as default for now. 

[h2]This weeks patch notes[/h2]
[h3]Updated[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated Inspect system
[list]
[*] Added a note for explaining controls.
[*] Can now close the menu with "E"
[*] Updated description on some items.
[*] General inspect UI updates.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some faulty lights in the school.
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could not use the shop.
[*] Fixed an issue where clients could not use the loadout.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed wisp effects.
[/list]

notes.title: First Update | v0.1.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
We are now happy to be releasing our first update. The first of many. 

[h2]Demo very soon[/h2]
There was plans to release the demo at the same time as the launch of the game in early access. But as some would have noticed, there was no demo since we did not really realize that the demo, using the same build as the main game, would need to go through steams review process. Woopsie. 
The demo should hopefully be going live later today. Or in the worst case scenario next week. There will be a new post announcing it. 

[h2]This weeks patch notes[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an interaction highlight issue for when handheld tools got in the way.
[*] Fixed faulty interaction popup for Wisp
[*] Fixed Chat widget issues.
[list]
[*] The chat widget was getting in the way of other widgets.
[/list][*] Fixed Hannya walk animation.
[*] Fixed an issue with displayed info in the lobby widget.
[*] Fixed an issue with photo gallery in the Journal.
[*] Fixed an player spawn issue in the Hub area.
[list]
[*] Skeletal meshes where spawning on top of each other.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed Sprit Camera to have an smaller mesh.
[*] Changed Flashlight socket reposition and Tool logic re-evaluation.
[*] Changed the main character model.
[/list]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new icons for various tools.   
[*] Added ambience sounds for Hub and School areas.
[*] Added an application icon the game.
[*] Added a bathtub to the Hub area. 
[/list]
